newsitem.title: BRAZIL: RESEARCH ALERT-Telebras still a Caspian buy.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT-Telebras still a Caspian buy.

text.p: Caspian Securities said it was maintaining its buy rating on Brazilian state-run telecommunications firm Telebras at the currently depressed prices.
-- said recent comments by Telebras director Daltron Magalhaes, indicating that Telebras would lower rates, have been totally overblown by the market.

-- Magalhaes said the company was preparing to cut rates to face upcoming competition with private service providers. He said the firm would reduce rates special rates for corporate users from August.
-- "However, the lower rate for business customers may not necessarily result in lower revenues or margins," said analysts Tony Figueiredo and Joanne Showalter in a report.
-- Telebras preferred was 5.78 percent lower at 138.50 reais at 1500 local/1800 GMT.
